# Knowledge before authority

Reference ID: `knowledge-and-authority` · Version: 2026-10-09 · Topics: authority, workflow

How SoftwareDLC separates public understanding from authenticated organization, project, branch, proposal, and lifecycle capabilities.

## Progressive authority

Section ID: `progressive-authority` (principles)

Public understanding is available before SoftwareDLC authentication or project selection.
Credentials identify a principal; scopes and permissions bound data access; exact bindings select project resources.
Consequential actions add operation-specific validation, concurrency controls, audit, and confirmation.

## Authority boundaries

Section ID: `authority-boundaries` (boundaries)

Public references cannot enumerate or infer private resources.
Project read authority does not imply project write authority.
Proposal write authority does not imply branch acceptance, commit, pull-request, approval, or merge authority.
Knowledge is global; data access is scoped; mutation is explicit; acceptance is separately authorized.
